WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.* , o.fulfilment_type, o.line_count, o.order_total_gross
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22')
SELECT 'dup_receipt_line' k, count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_or_zero_net', count(*) FROM l WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'net_gross_mismatch', count(*) FROM l WHERE abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02
UNION ALL SELECT 'linecount_mismatch', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, any_value(line_count) lc, count(*) c, sum(gross_amount) g, any_value(order_total_gross) t FROM l GROUP BY 1) WHERE lc<>c
UNION ALL SELECT 'total_mismatch', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, sum(gross_amount) g, any_value(order_total_gross) t FROM l GROUP BY 1) WHERE abs(g-t)>0.05
UNION ALL SELECT 'loaded_late_distinct', count(distinct etl_loaded_at) FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'in_stg_overlap', count(*) FROM l JOIN stg_sales_line_load s USING (sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_lines', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN l USING (sales_line_id)

WITH w AS (SELECT min(period_start_date) s, max(period_end_date) e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period IN (9,10)),
sales AS (
 SELECT o.fulfilment_type ft, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, count(distinct f.receipt_id) orders
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id, w
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN w.s AND w.e GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (
 SELECT o.fulfilment_type ft, sum(r.refund_net) refund
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id, w
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN w.s AND w.e GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'net_before_returns' m, 100.0*sum(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN net END)/sum(net) pct, sum(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN net END) cc, sum(net) tot FROM sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'gross', 100.0*sum(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN gross END)/sum(gross), sum(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN gross END), sum(gross) FROM sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', 100.0*sum(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN orders END)/sum(orders), sum(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN orders END), sum(orders) FROM sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'net_after_returns', 100.0*sum(CASE WHEN s.ft='click_and_collect' THEN s.net-coalesce(r.refund,0) END)/sum(s.net-coalesce(r.refund,0)), sum(CASE WHEN s.ft='click_and_collect' THEN s.net-coalesce(r.refund,0) END), sum(s.net-coalesce(r.refund,0)) FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (ft)
UNION ALL SELECT 'naive_channel_id3', 100.0*sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_id=3 THEN net_amount END)/sum(net_amount), sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_id=3 THEN net_amount END), sum(net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f, w WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN w.s AND w.e
